mechanisms.summary: Near-field shock-vortex coupling organizes entrainment and far-field hydrogen dispersion.

evidence_candidates.claim: NPR is the dominant tested control of hydrogen-jet momentum, shock structure, penetration, and entrainment across the dual-scale framework.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: Six case-specific pressure pairs span NPR 5-100; high NPR produces stronger internal shocks, larger penetration, and broader mixing.
evidence_candidates.potential_chapter_role: Near-field to far-field coupling under NPR control.

evidence_candidates.claim: Nozzle-hole diameter controls shear-layer growth and dispersion scale, with nonlinear saturation at larger diameters.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: Five nozzle diameters are compared at fixed NPR=10 and 300 K.
evidence_candidates.limitations: One fixed pressure ratio and temperature for the diameter sweep.

evidence_candidates.claim: Ambient temperature modifies boundary instability and lateral expansion but has a weaker effect on jet momentum than NPR or nozzle diameter.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: 300-800 K sweep at fixed NPR=10 and D=1 mm.
evidence_candidates.limitations: Nonreacting hydrogen; source uses an external property database within its own model, not the project extraction.

schema_gap_candidates.issue: No dedicated parameter name in Schema 1.1; exact explicit values are retained in note/evidence and a qualitative history registry.
